choosePosition: Choose a position to view win factors. Data from different positions is never blended.
observationalNotice: These are observational associations within the same champion and position. Use them for review, not as proof that changing a metric causes a win-rate change. Deltas cannot be added together.
bucketCaption: Metric ranges, observed win rates, deltas, and sample sizes for {{metric}}

unavailable.UNSUPPORTED_POSITION: The first win-factor release supports jungle only. Other positions will follow after role-specific validation.
unavailable.NOT_PUBLISHED: No win-factor publication has passed the release gates for this patch and filter.
unavailable.MIN_GAMES: This filter does not have enough games to show a reliable result.
unavailable.MIN_PLAYERS: This filter does not have enough independent players to show a reliable result.
unavailable.SPARSE_BUCKETS: Some metric groups were too small and were hidden to avoid misleading results and privacy risk.
unavailable.UNKNOWN: No win factors are available for this filter.
